svg.title: How Improvado MCP works: your AI client connects over MCP to the hosted Improvado MCP server with OAuth sign-in. The server reads marketing data from the sources connected to your Improvado workspace.
svg.desc: Diagram: your AI client (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI, Codex or another client that supports streamable HTTP and OAuth sign-in) connects over MCP to Improvado MCP, a hosted remote server with OAuth sign-in that applies your workspace permissions. The server reads marketing data from the sources connected to your Improvado workspace, for example Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Analytics 4, HubSpot, Salesforce and Shopify, out of 1,400+ data sources supported. Three steps: add the server to your client, sign in with Improvado, ask questions in plain language.
